name: zinterp_context_find_macro_value
description: zInterp_Context::FindMacroValue scans the interpreter macro table by name, optionally returns the matched entry, and returns the entry value.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja flags the inlined strcmp tail at 0x4c162a because the sbb-based compare result is not lifted cleanly; assembly review confirms it is a strcmp-style zero/nonzero comparison.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c15f0 validates macroTable at context offset 0x60, macroCount at offset 0x64, 8-byte zInterp_MacroEntry records, linear name comparison, optional outEntry storage, and null return for misses.
The native smoke verifies found, missing, and empty-table behavior, including that outEntry is written only on a match.
